external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Another node in the P2P network propagating blocks
external_entities.rationale: Network peers can be malicious and send invalid blocks. Block validation rules differ by fork, so validation must be applied correctly.

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract invoking precompiled contracts via CALL/STATICCALL
external_entities.rationale: Any contract can invoke precompiles with arbitrary data. Input must be validated thoroughly.

boundary_interactions.interaction: Implicit: contract provides input data to precompile

external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller
external_entities.description: Any contract or EOA that can invoke precompiles with arbitrary data
external_entities.rationale: Explicit recognition that callers are untrusted. Security validation subgraph models defense against malicious inputs.

boundary_interactions.interaction: Implicit: caller provides BLS input data

external_entities.name: Untrusted Input Source
external_entities.description: Calling contract providing potentially malicious input data
external_entities.rationale: Input to SHA256 can be arbitrary bytes of any length from untrusted sources.

external_entities.name: Delegated User Account
external_entities.description: A user account with EIP-7702 delegation that requests sponsored transactions
external_entities.rationale: User accounts with delegations are external entities that may request sponsored transactions. The delegation status must be verified at runtime.

misclassified_entities.original_description: Smart contract invoking SHA256 precompile via CALL/STATICCALL
misclassified_entities.reason: Borderline case - while the calling contract is within the EVM, it provides untrusted input data to the precompile. Could be considered valid as an external data source.
misclassified_entities.resolution: Merged with EXT-CALLER-CONTRACT as a unified entity for precompile callers

misclassified_entities.original_description: An EOF-format contract executing the EXTCODEADDRESS opcode
misclassified_entities.reason: This represents internal EVM execution context, not an external entity. The contract is already within the EVM sandbox.

misclassified_entities.original_description: Smart contract invoking BLS12-381 G2 precompiles via CALL/STATICCALL
misclassified_entities.reason: Duplicate of EXT-CALLER-CONTRACT, just for a different precompile operation. Should be unified.

misclassified_entities.original_description: Smart contract using pairing for signature verification or zkSNARK validation
misclassified_entities.reason: Duplicate of EXT-CALLER-CONTRACT, just for pairing operation. Should be unified.

trust_boundary_edges.validation_required: Fork-specific block validation (Frontier vs Homestead rules)
Input length validation (256 bytes), G1 point decoding, field element validation
Input length validation, G1/G2 point decoding, subgroup membership verification
Input length, field element bounds, curve point validation, subgroup membership
None required for SHA256 (accepts any length), gas metering per input size
Exact 192-byte input length, field element validation, versioned hash verification, KZG proof verification
EXTCODEADDRESS verification, whitelist check for delegation target

security_observations.observation: BLS12-381 precompiles require extensive validation including subgroup membership checks to prevent small subgroup attacks
security_observations.mitigation: Point validation sequence: length check, field element bounds, curve membership, subgroup membership

security_observations.observation: SHA256 precompile accepts arbitrary-length input which must be properly metered by gas
security_observations.mitigation: Gas cost scales with input word count (base + per-word)

security_observations.observation: KZG point evaluation requires trusted setup security assumption
security_observations.mitigation: Cryptographic security relies on trusted setup ceremony integrity

security_observations.observation: EXTCODEADDRESS enables runtime delegation verification for sponsorship contracts
security_observations.mitigation: Whitelist-based approval of delegation targets, verify delegation has not changed between transactions

security_observations.observation: Fork transitions (EIP-606 Homestead) require coordinated upgrades to prevent network partitioning
security_observations.mitigation: Block height-based activation with community coordination
